item.title: Key Mideast Oil Benchmark Hits 3-Month Low on Resilient Exports
item.description: A key benchmark for Middle East crude fell to its lowest in nearly three months, an indication of the resilience of the region’s exports despite intensifying Iranian attacks on shipping.

item.title: INR/USD: Indian Rupee Rises to Six-Week High on Jio Platforms IPO Flows
item.description: India’s rupee extended its gains to a six-week high, buoyed by foreign inflows into Jio Platforms Ltd.’s initial public offering.

item.title: CATL’s Slow Profit Growth Fans Fears for China Battery Peers
item.description: CATL’s slower-than-expected quarterly profit growth hit the battery giant’s shares as analysts warned that the company and peers may struggle to manage pressure from a revived domestic consumption tax and the end of other fiscal benefits.

item.title: Cameroon Bonds Surge With President Paul Biya's Succession Unclear
item.description: Cameroon is getting hammered by bond investors after a credit downgrade. Having a nonagenarian leader with no public succession plan doesn’t help.

item.title: Rubio to Discuss Venezuelan Crude with Ambani
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio hopes to discuss Venezuelan crude in his meeting with Reliance Industries' Chairman Mukesh Ambani at Jamnagar in India's western state of Gujarat. "This is a company that has the capability to refine the heavy crude that's produced in the western hemisphere, including from Venezuela," he told reporters on Wednesday. (Source: Bloomberg)
